text:
### Fraud Incidents  
**Fraud Amount: <£1,000**
- Handler: Financial Crime Team
- Level: 2
- Timeline: 24 hours
- Action: Investigate, block if ongoing, reimburse if customer fraud  
**Fraud Amount: £1,000–£10,000**
- Handler: Financial Crime Team + CRO
- Level: 3
- Timeline: 24 hours
- Action: Investigation + law enforcement contact (if warranted)
- Reimbursement: Within 10 days  
**Fraud Amount: >£10,000**
- Handler: CRO + CEO
- Level: 4–5
- Timeline: 4 hours
- Action: Investigation, law enforcement notification, Board update
- Reimbursement: Within 10 days
- Regulatory: May require SAR filing/notification

raw_entities.name: Fraud Incident Response Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for detecting, investigating, and resolving fraud incidents across three severity tiers based on fraud amount. The process defines handler roles, escalation levels, investigation timelines, reimbursement obligations, and regulatory reporting requirements.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation and Blocking
raw_entities.description: Initial investigation step for low-value fraud incidents under £1,000. Includes assessment of ongoing fraud activity and blocking of transactions or accounts if necessary.
context: Action: Investigate, block if ongoing, reimburse if customer fraud

raw_entities.name: Fraud Investigation with Law Enforcement Contact
raw_entities.description: Investigation step for mid-range fraud incidents between £1,000–£10,000. Includes potential contact with law enforcement authorities when warranted by the investigation findings.

raw_entities.name: Investigation with Law Enforcement Notification and Board Update
aliases: Investigation, law enforcement notification, Board update
raw_entities.description: Investigation step for high-value fraud incidents exceeding £10,000. Includes mandatory law enforcement notification and escalation to Board level with regulatory reporting considerations.
context: Action: Investigation, law enforcement notification, Board update

raw_entities.name: Customer Reimbursement Processing
raw_entities.description: Reimbursement step executed for confirmed customer fraud cases. Low-value incidents are reimbursed immediately; mid and high-value incidents are reimbursed within 10 days.

raw_entities.name: Financial Crime Team
raw_entities.description: Team responsible for investigating fraud incidents across low and mid-range severity tiers (under £10,000). Handles initial investigation, blocking decisions, and law enforcement coordination for incidents between £1,000–£10,000.

raw_entities.name: Chief Risk Officer
raw_entities.description: Senior executive responsible for handling mid-range and high-value fraud incidents. Participates in investigation and decision-making for incidents £1,000–£10,000 and above £10,000.

raw_entities.name: Chief Executive Officer
raw_entities.description: Executive-level authority responsible for high-value fraud incidents exceeding £10,000. Participates in investigation decisions and Board-level updates.

raw_entities.name: Level 2 — Financial Crime Team Fraud Response
raw_entities.description: First escalation tier for fraud incidents under £1,000. Handled by Financial Crime Team with 24-hour response timeline and authority to investigate and block ongoing fraud.

raw_entities.name: Level 3 — Financial Crime Team and CRO Fraud Response
raw_entities.description: Mid-range escalation tier for fraud incidents between £1,000–£10,000. Handled jointly by Financial Crime Team and CRO with 24-hour response timeline, law enforcement contact authority, and 10-day reimbursement obligation.

raw_entities.name: Level 4–5 — CRO and CEO Fraud Response
raw_entities.description: High-value escalation tier for fraud incidents exceeding £10,000. Handled by CRO and CEO with 4-hour response timeline, mandatory law enforcement notification, Board update requirement, and potential regulatory SAR filing.

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Activity Report Filing Checkpoint
raw_entities.description: Mandatory regulatory compliance gate for high-value fraud incidents exceeding £10,000. Determines whether a Suspicious Activity Report must be filed with the relevant authority based on investigation findings.

raw_entities.name: Low-Value Fraud Alert
raw_entities.description: Fraud detection alert for incidents under £1,000. Triggers investigation and potential blocking by Financial Crime Team with 24-hour response requirement.
context: Action: Investigate, block if ongoing, reimburse if customer fraud

raw_entities.name: Mid-Range Fraud Alert
raw_entities.description: Fraud detection alert for incidents between £1,000–£10,000. Triggers joint investigation by Financial Crime Team and CRO with law enforcement contact authority and 10-day reimbursement timeline.
context: Action: Investigation + law enforcement contact (if warranted)

raw_entities.name: High-Value Fraud Alert
raw_entities.description: Fraud detection alert for incidents exceeding £10,000. Triggers executive-level investigation by CRO and CEO with mandatory law enforcement notification, Board update, and potential regulatory SAR filing within 4-hour response window.
context: Action: Investigation, law enforcement notification, Board update

raw_entities.name: Suspicious Activity Report Filing Obligation
raw_entities.description: Regulatory obligation to file a Suspicious Activity Report with the relevant authority for high-value fraud incidents exceeding £10,000 when investigation findings warrant reporting.
